items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: I had people that make them trombone pairs like Mr. Pearson.

ctx.x: Which make do you like best?

The busher is a pretty good instrument. Good horn. Yes sir. I had that Kahn, he had a small bow, but this busher, I bought a big bow and a large bell. Give you more volume. Yeah. I had people that make them trombone pairs like Mr. Pearson. He used to get those special mouthpieces with a small hole. That's how he could make those high notes, but he couldn't make the low ones.
